title: Board Management — Create / Rename / Delete / Switch
description: Create boards, rename them, delete them, and switch the active board. The active board id is tracked in the store and persisted.
spec:
1. Create a new named board; verify it appears and becomes selectable
2. Rename an existing board; verify the header and switcher reflect the new name
3. Delete a board; verify its columns and cards are removed and no orphans remain
4. Switch the active board; verify the correct columns/cards render
5. Verify deleting the active board selects a sensible remaining board (or the default) rather than crashing
6. Verify board set and active-board id survive reload
